$comment: Part 5, gate-ON condition. Same baseline hooks as gate-off; strictTemplates on in both. The responsive gate is soft: gate-on layers no new hook, it swaps the task prompt to task-prompt-detail-form-responsive.md, which instructs the agent to run npm run check:responsive and fix until it passes. The prompt is the single variable, disclosed in responsive-spec.md as the soft-gate asymmetry.
